title: Sync refuses to push another session's local commits from a shared checkout
goal: kbgit.py sync --push refuses (exit 1, naming them) when the range holds commits a different Claude session made in this checkout, and the kb-sprint skill says each session works in its own clone or worktree. Answers SP-jtfo4ael's retrospective: other sessions ran backlog.py start and committed in the orchestrator's checkout, and one session's sync pushed another's local main.
